title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Dry Lips
description: Vaccinium myrtillus creams, derived from the bilberry plant, have been used to treat dry lips due to their moisturizing and protective properties. The antioxidants and flavonoids present in Vaccinium myrtillus creams help to soothe and calm dry, chapped lips, reducing inflammation and promoting hydration.
